tx:
The following actions will give a chance to drop this pet:
• making runes
• at a Runecrafting altar (including Ourania Altar)
• in the Runespan
• via the Abyss
• using unstable essence
• creating any of the rune pouches
• siphoning from the Runesphere in the Runespan
• imbuing weapons
• creating volatile runic bricks
• creating erratic effigies
The following actions will not give a chance to drop this pet:
• Handing in runes to the yellow wizard in the Runespan
• handing in rune dust to the pure energy core in the Runespan
• Using protean essence or unstable protean essence
• Playing a Minigame that rewards experience in this skill

Gaining this item is based on the amount of experience awarded at once; the more experience granted per item made, the greater the chance of gaining this pet. The chance is not affected by experience boosters.
In a purely mathematical format, the chance f of receiving the pet on any particular action is
f = \frac{(B / 28) \times S}{50,000,000}
Where:
• B is the base experience per action
• S is the virtual skill level. At 200 million experience, a flat bonus of 200 is applied to this value

When the aura depletes, talk to Xuan to receive a reward book. The aura must be depleted to get the reward. If the three hours is not up and the experience in skills has been received (check time remaining to see progress and also to see how many skills in which experience has been gained in during the active period), simply unequip the aura to deplete it.
Attempting to activate the aura while in possession of a reward book fails with the message:
You must claim and use your reward from the Jack of Trades aura before you can receive another.
The experience reward is
\tfrac{5}{2}\left(x^2-2x+100\right),
where x is the level of the skill on which players use the reward.
